name: Kamimachi
tagline: Shibuya in 24 minutes and Shinjuku in 27 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, served by Tokyu Setagaya Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 45 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 24 minutes to Shibuya and 50 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 34.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 34.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 32.2 m to 39.2 m, a difference of 7.0 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at さくら会世田谷中央病院, about 469 m away and 菊池外科病院, about 942 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Setagaya Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.
